sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणो धीमान् ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् आर्तवत् ।क्व सीत इति त्वया पृष्टा यथा इमे सहसा उथिताः ॥३-६४-२१॥
transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇo dhīmān jyeṣṭham bhrātaram ārtavat ।kva sīta iti tvayā pṛṣṭā yathā ime sahasā uthitāḥ ॥3-64-21॥

translations.english: O lord these deer are indicating the land on the southern side.Therefore it will be proper for both of us to proceed in the southwestern direction. Maybe we will get some clue or find that noble Sita.
